description: Fetch an oral argument recording by audio_id from courtlistener_search_oral_arguments. Returns case metadata, panel IDs, duration, MP3 URL, docket and available transcript. Oversized text or metadata returns outline then page responses; continue retrieval.next_cursor as cursor with the unchanged ID/sections selection until null. The argument date comes from search or the linked docket.

cursor.description: Retrieval next_cursor from the previous response. Repeat the original ID and sections/categories selection unchanged; omit to start.

id.description: Audio recording ID — the audio_id field from a courtlistener_search_oral_arguments result.

sections.description: Selected record fields. Metadata is always selected; a nonempty selection omitting transcript excludes it. Omit for the whole record. Oversized selections page; keep this selection unchanged while following cursor.

name: courtlistener_get_oral_argument

docket_id.description: Associated docket ID; 0 if not linked.

download_url.description: Direct MP3 download URL; null if not available.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: Retrieval cursor is malformed, out of range or belongs to another request. `stale_cursor`: The normalized selected source changed since the previous page. `not_found`: Audio ID does not exist in CourtListener. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. `unknown_section`: A requested sections name is not a field of the oral argument record. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_transcript.description: True if a speech-to-text transcript is available.

judges.description: Free-text judge names; often empty on this endpoint.

kind.description: 'full' carries a small selected record; 'outline' pages the section catalog; 'page' carries fields and text chunks. Bounded identity remains present throughout retrieval.

panel_ids.description: Person IDs of panel judges — pass to courtlistener_get_judge.

retrieval.description: Caller retrieval completion, separate from upstream source completion.

next_cursor.description: Continue with cursor and the same ID/selection; null when this fetched view is exhausted.

ranges.description: Absolute source coordinates; merge typed rows by index rather than appending duplicates.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the normalized unsliced selected view.

total.description: Length of the complete normalized collection or text field.

text_chunks.description: Text omitted from partial rows/metadata, recoverable exactly using the matching ranges.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the original string field or string-array element.

text.description: Unescaped normalized substring, matching its code_points range.

retrieval_notice.description: How to continue bounded retrieval using the unchanged ID and selection.

sections.description: Section catalog: transcript and paged metadata fields. Follow retrieval.next_cursor to finish the catalog and retrieve data.

items.description: A withheld section of the record and its serialized byte size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

transcript.description: Speech-to-text transcript; empty if transcription has not completed. Oversized text is recovered through retrieval.text_chunks at /transcript.

title: Get Oral Argument
